summary: Tested Support Tickets feature - Backend APIs all working, Frontend has CRITICAL navigation bug preventing access to Support Tickets section

ui_bugs.issue: Support Tickets navigation item is NOT visible in Network Dashboard. NAV_ITEMS.slice(0,5) only shows first 5 items, Support is 6th item and not included in More dropdown

integration_issues.issue: Support Tickets section exists in code (line 978-981 NetworkDashboard.js) but is inaccessible from UI because navigation item is hidden

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: In NetworkHeader.js, add Support Tickets to the More dropdown or increase NAV_ITEMS.slice(0,6) to show 6 items instead of 5
The Support item at line 89 needs to be visible - either in main pills or in OVERFLOW_ITEMS
Alternative fix: Move support-tickets from NAV_ITEMS to OVERFLOW_ITEMS so it appears in More dropdown
critical_code_review_comments: NetworkHeader.js line 208: NAV_ITEMS.slice(0, 5) excludes the 6th item (Support Tickets)
NetworkHeader.js lines 244-272: More dropdown only renders OVERFLOW_ITEMS and LINK_ITEMS, not remaining NAV_ITEMS
The Support Tickets section is fully implemented in NetworkDashboard.js (line 978-981) but unreachable from UI
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed tickets created during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for Support Tickets are fully working. The critical issue is in NetworkHeader.js - the Support Tickets navigation item is defined but not visible because NAV_ITEMS.slice(0,5) only shows first 5 items. Fix requires either: 1) Change slice to (0,6), 2) Add support-tickets to OVERFLOW_ITEMS, or 3) Add remaining NAV_ITEMS to More dropdown. User-side ticket icon testing was blocked by welcome dialog redirect issue.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In NetworkHeader.js, NAV_ITEMS contains 6 items but only first 5 are rendered in pill navigation (line 208: NAV_ITEMS.slice(0, 5)). The More dropdown (lines 244-272) only renders OVERFLOW_ITEMS and LINK_ITEMS, not the remaining NAV_ITEMS.
reproduction_steps: 3. Look for Support in navigation pills - NOT VISIBLE
4. Click More dropdown - Support NOT in dropdown either
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Change line 208 from NAV_ITEMS.slice(0, 5) to NAV_ITEMS.slice(0, 6) OR add support-tickets to OVERFLOW_ITEMS array
